comments.text: One of the best things I've seen in years . Funny, insightful and cuts to the quick of where America (world) is going on so many subjects,. How in hell was it cancelled.

comments.text: And of course this show was cancelled... can't get ppl thinking too hard about their own lives! Too dangerous for the system.

comments.author: @VirtueInsightWebPage
comments.text: This show was incredibly clever, and made some phenomenal hard hitting philosophical investigations on western society and the dwindling success of achieving the "American Dream" or pursuit of happiness in the age of Disillusionment. This show was a reality check and a breath of fresh air in a toxic world of capitalism on overdrive and the cultural collapse of western civilization. This show was unjustly torn apart by critics and it's message was tasteful and relatable to the brokenhearted and disillusioned of society. Truly a masterpiece, and I genuinely hope for a reemergence; perhaps possible as it is available on Netflix.
